description: A program director must finalize a returning employee's reintegration plan after an extended leave, deciding her client-facing role, temporary meeting schedule, peer support, and formal review point.

shared_context.S1: Inez is returning to the program after an extended leave, and the team needs a written reintegration plan.
shared_context.S2: The program director decides Inez's temporary responsibilities, working arrangements, peer support, and follow-up process.
shared_context.S3: The team has several client calls and internal coordination meetings scheduled during Inez's first few weeks back.
shared_context.S4: As part of the program's normal reintegration review, Elena asks Inez, a peer colleague, Inez's line manager, and HR to give their relevant input in turn before the plan is finalized.
shared_context.S5: Elena's normal meeting practice is to have each participant place relevant plan inputs on the record through the formal disclosure step before the plan is discussed or finalized.

PF1.text: For her first 15 working days back, Inez can reliably take client calls only from 1:00 p.m. onward because of a temporary personal-care arrangement; she has not raised the exact timing with Elena because she does not want to discuss the arrangement broadly.

PF2.text: Marta has already volunteered to be Inez's peer buddy for the first 20 working days, including a twice-weekly check-in; this was agreed informally and is not in the staffing plan.

PF3.text: Dev observed Inez successfully handle three difficult client escalations before her leave and believes she should remain the client-escalation liaison rather than be removed from that responsibility; Dev has not updated the draft plan.

PF4.text: Ruth confirmed that the reintegration plan must include a formal review after exactly 20 working days; she checked the current HR guidance this week, but the requirement has not yet been added to Elena's packet.

acceptance_conditions: Inez must remain the client-escalation liaison during reintegration.
Inez's client calls must begin at 1:00 p.m. or later during the temporary period.
Marta must be assigned as Inez's peer buddy with twice-weekly check-ins.
The plan must schedule its formal review after exactly 20 working days.
The settlement must include a documented reintegration-review commitment.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'reintegration_review' and c['target'] == 'Inez' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Inez's temporary-care arrangement changes the client-call start time from an ordinary workday schedule to exactly 1:00 p.m.
Marta's prior volunteer agreement changes the peer-support assignment to Marta with the specific twice-weekly check-in arrangement.
Dev's three observed escalations change Inez's temporary role from being removed from client escalation work to remaining the client-escalation liaison.
Ruth's confirmed HR guidance changes the follow-up from an unspecified check-in to a formal reintegration review after exactly 20 working days.
